seoTitle: Book a Live Caricature Artist for Your Event in Lagos | I Do Art Studios
seoDescription: Book live caricature entertainment for your wedding, birthday or corporate event in Lagos. Tell us the date and we'll reply on WhatsApp with availability and a quote.
heading: Book live caricature for your event
intro: Tell us the date and a few details. We'll reply on WhatsApp with availability and a quote.
contactStepTitle: Where should we send your quote?
contactStepHint: We'll send availability and your quote to this WhatsApp number.
sendHint: Opens WhatsApp with your event details written out. Nothing is booked or paid yet.
sentBody: WhatsApp should have opened with your event details. Press Send there and we'll come back to you with availability and a quote.

facts.title: Pioneer artist
facts.body: Led by Owolabi (Mr. Caricature), a member of the International Society of Caricature Artists (ISCA).

facts.title: Fast, funny, accurate
facts.body: Live sketching that keeps guests gathered and laughing — weddings, corporate parties and VIP gatherings.

facts.title: Keepsakes guests take home
facts.body: Every guest drawn leaves with a digital or printed caricature of themselves.
